about.heroSubtitle: Bihar's Most Trusted Name in Commercial Vehicles Since 1995
about.storyContent: Since 1995, Patliputra Automobiles has been Bihar's premier destination for commercial vehicles. What started as a small dealership in Patna has grown into a trusted network serving customers across Bihar and Jharkhand. Our commitment to quality, transparency, and customer satisfaction has made us the #1 choice for JCB machines, Ashok Leyland trucks, and Switch electric vehicles.

about.pillar4Desc: Dedicated service network across Bihar for quick assistance
about.networkDesc: With service centers in Patna, Muzaffarpur, Bhagalpur, Gaya, and Darbhanga, we ensure your vehicles are always running at peak performance.
